activityCounters.zh-CN: 读取 {read} · 搜索 {search} · 命令 {command} · {duration}

toggleGroupsDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：展开或收起全部动作组
toggleGroupsDescription.en-US: Clean mode: expand or collapse all action groups

groupsExpandedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已展开全部动作组，按 {key} 收起
groupsExpandedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: all action groups expanded, press {key} to collapse

groupsCollapsedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已收起全部动作组，按 {key} 展开
groupsCollapsedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: all action groups collapsed, press {key} to expand

toggleDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：收起或展开本轮工作过程
toggleDescription.en-US: Clean mode: collapse or expand this run's work

configDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：打开配置面板，或直接写 key=on/off
configDescription.en-US: Clean mode: open the settings panel, or pass key=on/off

configDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后完全按 Pi 的原始方式渲染，不再折叠任何内容
configDescEnabled.en-US: When off, Pi renders tool output exactly as it does by default

configDescShowRunHeader.zh-CN: 收起后在最终答案上方显示「用时 Ns · N 步」
configDescShowRunHeader.en-US: Show "Took Ns · N steps" above the final answer when collapsed

configDescAutoExpand.zh-CN: 运行过程中显示工作过程，运行结束后自动收起
configDescAutoExpand.en-US: Show work while the run is active and collapse it when the run settles

configDescActionGroups.zh-CN: 把同一轮的多条工具调用收成一行组头
configDescActionGroups.en-US: Collapse a turn's tool calls into a single group header

configDescActivityArea.zh-CN: 运行中在整轮最上方显示「现在在做什么」
configDescActivityArea.en-US: Show what is running at the top of the current run

configDescActivityRows.zh-CN: 活动区最多占用的行数；回车后选择具体数字
configDescActivityRows.en-US: Maximum rows used by the activity area; press enter to pick a number

configDescAnimateActivity.zh-CN: 关闭后活动区只显示静止标记
configDescAnimateActivity.en-US: When off, the activity area shows a static marker

configDescHideThinking.zh-CN: 收起模型的思考原文，只保留结论
configDescHideThinking.en-US: Strip the model's reasoning text and keep conclusions

collapsedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已收起工作过程，按 {key} 展开
collapsedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: work collapsed, press {key} to expand

expandedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已展开工作过程，按 {key} 收起
expandedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: work expanded, press {key} to collapse

configSaveFailed.zh-CN: 清爽模式配置保存失败：{error}
configSaveFailed.en-US: Failed to save clean mode configuration: {error}

loadFailed.zh-CN: 清爽模式配置读取失败，已使用默认值：{error}
loadFailed.en-US: Failed to read clean mode configuration, using defaults: {error}

notTuiMode.zh-CN: 清爽模式仅在交互式 TUI 下生效
notTuiMode.en-US: Clean mode only applies in interactive TUI mode
